column1: # NeoForge -> Fabric/shim class mapping table (TSV: old_fqcn, new_fqcn, [mode])
# Rule: shim classes keep the NeoForge simple name so only import lines change.
# Phase 1 "easy" mappings — extended as phases land.
# --- fake player (Fabric API ships one; shim adapts constructor surface) ---
# unchanged: the port depends on NeoForge's standalone bus library (net.neoforged:bus, JiJ'd).
# --- registries (Phase 1: shim replays the NeoForge registration lifecycle on the mod bus) ---
# --- fluids: Mekanism-owned FluidStack (mB amounts internally; droplet conversion only at the
#     Phase 2 transfer-API boundary). Serialized formats match NeoForge's byte-for-byte. ---
# --- capabilities: tokens over Fabric API Lookup (registration/queries wired in Phase 2) ---
# --- item handlers (simulate-based internal contract; Phase 2 bridges at boundary) ---
# --- data maps (types + store now; datapack loader lands Phase 3) ---
# --- events (game-bus glue fires these in Phase 3; classes compile-ready now) ---
# --- ingredients: NeoForge-format JSON via shim codecs; bridged into Fabric's custom-ingredient
#     system (registered under NeoForge's type ids) for vanilla recipe slots + network sync ---
# Mostly NO remap needed: Forge Config API Port (Fabric) provides net.neoforged.fml.config.*
# package names. The ModContainer shim routes registerConfig through FCAP's NeoForgeConfigRegistry
# and bridges FCAP's config callbacks onto the shim mod bus as ModConfigEvents.
# --- game events: server lifecycle / level / tags / commands / reload ---
